name: WYETHIA HELENOIDES
key_symptoms: Sense of weight. Belching of wind alternating with hiccough. Nausea and vomiting.
Nervous, uneasy, depressed. Dizzy. Rush of blood to head. Sharp pain in forehead.
Dry, hacking cough, caused by tickling of the epiglottis. Burning sensation in the bronchial tubes. Tendency to get hoarse talking or singing; throat hot, dry. Dry asthma.
Pain in back; extends to end of spine. Pain right arm, stiffness of wrist and hand. Aching pains all over.

urinary_symptoms: Pain in left ovary, shooting down to knee. Pain in uterus; could outline its contour.

fever_symptoms: Chill at 11 am. Thirst for ice-water during chill. No thirst with heat. Profuse sweat all night. Terrific headache during sweat.
